description: This file defines the ProfileRepository class responsible for managing user connection profiles, stored in SharedPreferences, and providing a reactive Flow to observe profile list changes. It includes methods to add and load profiles, handle default profile logic, and ensure thread-safe singleton access.

classes.name: ProfileRepository
classes.description: Singleton class that manages profiles, persists data in SharedPreferences, and exposes a reactive Flow<List<Profile>> for observation.

methods.name: addProfile
methods.description: Adds a new profile to the repository; updates the list, persists it, and manages default profile setting.

methods.name: loadProfilesFromPrefs
methods.description: Loads the persisted list of profiles from SharedPreferences, parsing JSON, and handling defaults.

methods.name: saveProfilesToPrefs
methods.description: Serializes and saves the list of profiles into SharedPreferences.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Provides a thread-safe singleton instance of ProfileRepository.
